findings.decision: Legacy Iki Station/Station Staff label replaced with explicitly fictional island bus information counter. Active NPC_CATEGORIES supports Bus Terminal; no railway or unsupported port category introduced.
Government Officer handles community venue enquiry routing, not automatic reservation acceptance or loud-music permission.
Nurse retains nursing support role; hands receipt/date and document applications to accounting/reception, no disclosure guarantee or certificate issuance.
Police records borrowed-property loss and uncertain serial without claiming ownership or guaranteed recovery.
Postal Clerk refuses to promise unconsented neighbor handoff or immediate retrieval from another holding counter.
Bank Clerk handles own-bank card only, distinguishes stopping from reissue and other-issuer verification.
Supermarket Staff records purchase and seal state and refers exchange decision without guaranteeing food exchange.
Community Staff provides fictional park rest route; no walking time, medical suitability or guaranteed actual layout.
